title: dpl.lesson/1 — one lesson: an ordered run of uses of library slides
description: A lesson kept at <content>/library/lessons/<id>/lesson.json (LS3, R285). It never holds a slide's content: each use points at a library slide by id and pins one revision of it, so a slide that moves on shows Update available instead of changing the lesson under the operator. Looks, presets and components float. docs/plans/lessons-ls3.md §4.2.

id.description: A permanent ULID — never a folder name.

rev.description: Raised by one on every change; an episode pins it.

uses.description: In teaching order. The same slide may be used more than once, each use with its own key.

key.description: Names this use within its lesson.

slide.description: The library slide and the revision this lesson shows.

role.description: The job this use does — Gagné's nine events, in teaching order.

declined.description: The newer revision the operator said Not now to.
